summary: Added Graph.cbd(self, resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph. It implements the W3C CBD rules: subject triples with recursive blank-node expansion guarded by "result has no triple with that subject", then reifier triples for every node with rdf:subject pointing at the resource (no rdf:Statement or predicate/object checks). The docstring describes this behavior. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (setUp parses a Turtle fixture, tearDown closes the graph) and tests for rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion in reification, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Expected counts were checked by hand against the fixture only. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified. Nothing was committed, and no documentation page was added.
